title: Optim-Agent/optim-agent
claim: Optim-Agent/optim-agent — LLM agents as your hyperparameter optimizer.
why_good: Uses LLM agents to drive hyperparameter optimization — an interesting angle (reasoning over search) for a real, costly ML pain.
value: Sell to ML teams as an optimization service/tool; compute savings from smarter search justify paying.
risk: HPO is well-served (Optuna, W&B Sweeps); LLM-driven search must prove it beats classic methods on cost/quality.

zh.claim: Optim-Agent/optim-agent —— 用 LLM agent 当你的超参数优化器。
zh.why_good: 用 LLM agent 驱动超参数优化——对真实、昂贵的 ML 痛点,一个有意思的角度(用推理指导搜索)。
zh.value: 作为优化服务/工具卖给 ML 团队;更聪明搜索省下的算力足以让人付费。
zh.risk: HPO 已有成熟工具(Optuna、W&B Sweeps);LLM 驱动搜索要证明在成本/质量上胜过经典方法。

pick_reason: The project addresses a significant pain point in machine learning with a novel approach, showing potential for commercialization.
